name: What preparation do I need to do before Frasheski Construction installs new outdoor lighting?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do before Frasheski Construction installs new outdoor lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before Frasheski Construction installs new outdoor lighting, you should decide on the specific locations for each fixture and consider how you want to control them (e.g., switches, dimmers, motion sensors). Having a clear idea of your preferred layout helps us plan wiring paths and power connections efficiently. Also, ensure the exterior areas are accessible and free from obstructions for our electricians.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before outdoor lighting installation, decide on fixture locations and controls. Ensure exterior areas are accessible and clear for our team.
